why: Ledger for criterion 1 of the mobile-conversion acceptance list (docs/audits/2026-10-03-frontend-design-system-audit.md §5.5):
"no page renders a table as its primary content below 768px; every table has a card-stack alternative."
status "converted"    - the tables that carry content below md render through components/ui/CardStackTable;
the table itself is now `hidden md:block`. `remaining` counts tables in the same file
that stay tables, with the reason.
status "cardStacked"  - the file already had a phone card list; the table is the md+ branch.
status "allowListed"  - a table that is not the phone view of its content, with the reason it may stay one.
Every entry is asserted against a live scan of frontend/src by __tests__/tableStack.test.js, so a new table or
a removed conversion fails the suite instead of quietly shipping a sideways scroll.
convertedWithoutComponent: components/district/DistrictBriefBody.tsx: the event log became a key/value card grid below md (one row per card).
components/status/FreshnessPanel.tsx: the source table became a definition list below md.

components/DisasterDetailModalUI.tsx.reason: print sheet inside a modal; the modal body above it carries the same fields as cards.

components/alerts/DistrictAlertTable.tsx.reason: the phone view is the card list above the table and the table wrapper is `hidden ... md:block`; only the wider-screen table remains.

components/district/DistrictBriefBody.ts.remainingReason: the upazila section's default view is already the card grid; this table is the explicit Table toggle, holding the same rows.

components/map/MapDistrictTable.tsx.reason: the console's second view of the same rows: the primary view below md is the map, and this table is reached through the 44px Map/Table toggle. Its phone equivalent IS the map.

components/status/FreshnessPanel.tsx.remainingReason: the coverage-horizon table is two columns (Horizon, Units) and the provenance table is text that already wraps; neither scrolls at 320px, so they stay tables in both themes.

pages/AdvisoriesPage.tsx.reason: the screen view is already a card list above this table; the table itself is the print protocol sheet (print-table classes), which only exists on paper.
